announcements: 🎉 Welcome to the Google Cloud Arcade Community Progress Dashboard!
🚀 Track your learning journey, earn Skill Badges, and build your cloud skills.
🏅 Make sure your Google Cloud Skills Boost profile is set to public to sync your progress.
motivationalMessages: One Arcade Game today is better than none.
Small progress each day leads to big achievements.
Every Skill Badge earned is real cloud expertise you own forever.
